Todas as páginas compartilham a mesma estrutura. Agora vou criar o script de batch processing e aplicar todas as mudanças:
Action: $ cd /tmp/site-repo && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re, os, glob

html_files = glob.glob('*.html')

for f in html_files:
    with open(f, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    
    original = content
    
    # 1. Add scroll-progress div if not present (before <canvas id="webgl">)
    if 'scroll-progress' not in content:
        content = content.replace(
            '<canvas id="webgl" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>',
            '<div class="scroll-progress" aria-hidden="true"></div>\n    <canvas id="webgl" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>'
        )
    
    # 2. Add GSAP preload if not present
    if 'preload" href="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"' not in content:
        content = content.replace(
            '<script defer src="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>',
            '<link rel="preload" href="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js" as="script">\n    <script defer src="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>'
        )
    
    # 3. Fix boot image loading="lazy" if present (bug fix for any page)
    content = content.replace(
        'fetchpriority="high"\n       loading="lazy"',
        'fetchpriority="high"'
    )
    
    if content != original:
        with open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(content)
        print(f"Updated: {f}")
    else:
        print(f"No changes: {f}")

PYEOF

/* === PAGE TRANSITIONS === */
@keyframes pageEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); filter: blur(3px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); }
}
@keyframes pageExit {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); }
  to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); filter: blur(4px); }
}
body:not(.is-locked) main {
  animation: pageEnter .55s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) both;
}
body.page-leaving main {
  animation: pageExit .35s cubic-bezier(.55, 0, 1, .45) both;
  pointer-events: none;
}
body.page-leaving .nav,
body.page-leaving .site-footer {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .25s ease;
}"

Agora adicionar o sistema de page transitions no JS:
Action: file_editor str_replace /tmp/site-repo/assets/js/main.js --old-str "initScrollProgress();

initMatrixCanvas();" --new-str "initScrollProgress();

// === PAGE TRANSITIONS ===
function initPageTransitions() {
  const isInternal = (href) => {
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('mailto:') || href.startsWith('tel:') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return false;
    if (href.startsWith('http')) {
      try { return new URL(href).hostname === location.hostname; } catch { return false; }
    }
    return true;
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const link = e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (!link || link.target === '_blank' || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey) return;
    const href = link.getAttribute('href');
    if (!isInternal(href)) return;
    // Allow anchor links on same page
    if (href.startsWith('#')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    document.body.classList.add('page-leaving');
    setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = href; }, 320);
  });
}
initPageTransitions();

initMatrixCanvas();"
